summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 10, 2026, covering open-market repurchases of Class A ordinary shares (HKEX 09888, multi-counter 89888 RMB) executed September 7-10, 2026. Four daily tranches of 545,000, 554,150, 541,200 and 557,200 shares, each roughly 0.025% of existing issued shares, were bought at HKD 91.6772, 90.2251, 92.383 and 89.7264 respectively, totaling about 2.2 million shares for cancellation, not yet cancelled. Issued shares stayed at 2,209,541,178; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch execution pace, cancellation timing and buyback capacity under the mandate.
